subject: Security sprint: MAP + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA path for BankingCorp
messages:
From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@bankingcorp.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bankingcorp.com, security@bankingcorp.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP: security sprint & evidence window

Aisha —

Thanks for the productive demo yesterday. BankingCorp is ready to move from evaluation to a short security sprint so our InfoSec and procurement teams can sign off. Can you propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the security/compliance gates we need to clear? High-level asks from my side:

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed) and high-level control coverage
- SIG/CAIQ mapping for the implementation details we saw (auth, key management, network segmentation)
- DPA draft and confirmation on retention defaults and per-customer retention options
- Example audit logs / sample retention logs (preferably last 30/90-day examples)

Target: close commercial review and security acceptance within ~6 weeks so we can finalize PO. We’ll need clear owners and milestone dates in the MAP.

Attaching BankingCorp evidence intake template so you can slot items against requirements.

Thanks — I’ll loop in procurement and security contacts after we agree the plan.

—Mark Jensen
CTO, BankingCorp
mark.jensen@bankingcorp.com

Attachment: BankingCorp-evidence-template.xlsx (spreadsheet template)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@bankingcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: security sprint & evidence window

Mark —

Appreciate the clear asks and the template. I’ve drafted a concise MAP to hit the 6-week target and to make security review as frictionless as possible. High-level snapshot below; I’ll attach a one-page MAP and a proposed schedule.

MAP snapshot (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): MAP agreed, DPA draft shared, kickoff call scheduled (Redwood security + BankingCorp InfoSec)
- Week 1: SOC 2 artifacts shared (redacted), CAIQ spreadsheet populated, initial Q&A captured
- Week 2: Deep-dive session on key management & network model (Rishi + Ava)
- Week 3: Evidence intake complete, minor config change notes captured for acceptance
- Week 4–5: DPA redlines resolved, legal review, procurement terms finalized
- Week 6: Security acceptance decision and PO submission

Owners: Redwood Security (Rishi) for artifacts and controls mapping; Solutions Engineering (Ava) for architecture deep-dive; Me (Aisha) for MAP coordination and procurement sequencing.

Deliverables I will share now: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (one-page milestones + owners) and an intake worksheet pre-filled against your template. Please review and tell me any must-have milestones we missed. Also confirm your preferred window/time for a 60-minute technical security call — Rishi and Ava will join.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf; prefilled-intake.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@bankingcorp.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: security sprint & evidence window

Mark / Aisha —

Quoting Aisha: "MAP snapshot (draft)" — thanks. A few clarifications from the security side so BankingCorp has everything for its checklist:

1) SOC 2 (Type II): We can share the full SOC 2 report with standard redactions for customer data and 3rd-party details. Link: https://redwoodsharing.example.com/soc2/SOC2-2026-redacted.pdf (will provide access control).

2) CAIQ / SIG: We maintain a completed CAIQ mapping for our hosted service. I’ll attach CAIQ-complete.xlsx and a short mapping doc that points to the control owners and evidence artifacts.

3) DPA / retention: Our standard DPA includes a default retention window of 90 days for short-lived inference logs (configurable per-customer). We support contractual options for 30 days (stricter) or 365 days (long-term) with appropriate pricing/commitments. We use customer-managed KMS support (Bring Your Own Key) and HSM-backed keys for secure encryption at rest. I’ll attach DPA-draft.docx for redlining.

4) Evidence samples: We can provide sanitized example logs and a sample audit export for the last 90 days. Let us know if you need specific tenancy IDs to map.

5) Encryption & key management: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit, optional BYOK via AWS KMS/Google Cloud KMS or customer HSM via partner integrations. We will state this in the MAP and call out where we hold keys vs where customer-managed keys are used.

I’m happy to run the technical session and will prepare a short slide deck that maps BankingCorp requirements to Redwood artifacts. Proposed dates: Thu 6 May 10:00–11:00 PT or Mon 10 May 14:00–15:00 PT.

—Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-2026-redacted.pdf; CAIQ-complete.xlsx; DPA-draft.docx

From: Mark Jensen <mark.jensen@bankingcorp.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bankingcorp.com, procurement@bankingcorp.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP: security sprint & evidence window

Aisha / Rishi —

This is helpful — thank you. A few follow-ups before the kickoff call:

- We need explicit confirmation in the DPA about who controls encryption keys by default (Redwood-managed) and the steps for BYOK activation and revocation. Can you add the activation playbook to the DPA appendix?
- For retention: default 90 days is acceptable, but our legal wants an option in the DPA that makes 30-day retention the default for certain regulated workloads. Please flag any technical limitations for returning to 30 days if we later request it.
- Compliance artifacts: we’ll review the SOC 2 and CAIQ but request a short statement of whether there are any open remediations (and their severity).
- In the evidence template I attached a column for sample log exports per API tenant — can Redwood populate that column during the intake?

We prefer the Thu 6 May slot. Please confirm the call invite and include any pre-read materials. Also share the DocuSign link once the DPA is ready for legal redlines.

—Mark
CTO, BankingCorp

Attachment: BankingCorp-evidence-template.xlsx (updated with tenant columns)

Mark —

Action items / next steps (owner / ETA):

Best regards,
Aisha Rahman
